test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

We had hundreds of __courageous__ scientists.
solution: The correct answer is** 'diffident'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • This is an antonym in context question where we need to find the** antonym** of the underlined word from the given options: • The given word 'Courageous' **means **very brave, having or showing courage.(साहसी, हिम्‍मती) • ***Example: **He was a courageous man who never complained about his weaknesses.* • *​*The marked option** 'diffident' **means not having confidence in your own strengths or abilities.(आत्‍मसंशयी, अपनी शक्ति या योग्‍यता में विश्‍वास न रखने वाला; आत्‍मविश्‍वासहीन) • As the meanings of** 'courageous'** and **'diffident**' are opposite to each other, this shows that they are **antonyms** of each other.​ • Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Gutsy **: having or showing courage, determination, and spirit.(साहसी) • **Audacious**: willing to take risks or do something shocking(ख़तरा उठाने या स्‍तब्‍धकारी कार्य करने को तैयार; निर्भीक, निडर) • **Valiant **: full of courage and not afraid(साहसी और निर्भीक) 3d:T544, The correct answer is** 'foiled.'**
